hold: P0 held; core 539 MHz, memory 900 MHz (not a maximum-core lock)
release: P0 request released; automatic performance states restored

rom.scope: Nine-clock GK104/GM107 BIOS clock-state table only; labels cross-checked with GTX 690 and the supplied edited GM107 ROM. Nouveau source names refer to GK104. Stored frequencies do not establish live clocks, writable controls, NVAPI domain IDs, or factory settings.

protocol: Four samples per state: idle, normal CUDA boost, verified P0 hold idle and loaded, then release. No voltage, fan, offset or ROM writes. Original raw labels captured before the new Maxwell mapping; mapping interpretation is in the accompanying Markdown.
